before_start.title: Working Guidelines — always apply:
items: Goal is the process, not the result. Follow the given process fully — don't skip steps to rush to a solution.
Listen to the user's insights and prompts. Ignoring them wastes their time.
Always explain reasoning and architectural choices BEFORE taking action. Mention alternatives considered and why they were rejected. Do not code until the approach is validated.
Write all code coment in english.
